Name: Item Bags for ES
Author: passersby10086
Description:
[size=4]属于East Scarp和附属mod的物品袋。在物品袋最新的beta测试版的基础上编辑的自定义袋子，包括了ES和它的附属mod的几乎有所物品。在item bag的最新功能下，袋子可以根据添加的mod自动匹配物品，这意味着你可以仅仅只是安装其中部分mod，不会出现袋子中的物品异常的情况。并且，如果对应的mod更新添加了新物品，袋子也能自动识别新物品并加入袋子里，不用担心版本更新导致遗漏物品。

要注意，因为熊家族和剑&魔法的物品数量太多，我为它们单独制作了一个袋子作为可选文件。

除了ES是必须的，其他的前置是可选的
[/size]
[size=4]
[/size][size=4]Item bags belonging to East Scarp and affiliated MOds. A custom bag edited based on the latest beta version of the item Bag, including almost all items from ES and its affiliated mods. Under the latest feature of item bag, the bag can automatically match items based on the added mods. This means that you can only install some of the mods and there will be no abnormal situation of the items in the bag. Moreover, if the corresponding mod update adds new items, the bag can automatically recognize the new items and add them to the bag, so there is no need to worry about missing items due to version updates.
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]Please note that because there are too many items of the Bear Family and Sword & Magic, I have made a separate bag for them as[/size] an optional file.
[size=4]
Except for ES which is mandatory, the other prefixes are optional[/size]
